notes: The hard poll: WhatsApp shows each voter's own contact display name, which is often
the long form the sheet stores short, and sometimes only a first name that collides.
Ambiguity rule (plan, Design of NameMatcher): a first-name-only hit must SUGGEST all
candidates and auto-pick none — 'Alex', 'Dan' and 'Laura' are the real 2026 collisions.
'Dan' is listed as ambiguous even though it is itself a roster key: with 'Dan B' also
on the roster the app must ask rather than guess. If U5 decides exact-key equality
should win instead, change it in the plan first, then here.
OCR damage exercised: 'Cel este' (word split) -> 'Celeste', 'Tarquln' (l/i confusion)
